title: A Summer Fair
strapline: Bunting, stalls and games galore — roll up for the summer fair.
intent: A summer fair brings the whole community together in joyful, purposeful play — running stalls, games and a celebration.
Planning and running stalls — a tombola, a coconut shy, a cake stall — is rich role-play with real jobs to do.
Handling coins, tickets and prizes weaves in counting, money and comparing amounts.
Working together to prepare and host the fair grows cooperation, responsibility and pride.
The fair is a celebration of summer, community and the fun of doing something together.
implementation: Plan the fair with the children — what stalls and games shall we have? — and let them prepare and run them.
Set up stalls with real jobs: a ticket seller, a hoopla, a cake stall, a lucky dip, face-painting, a splash game.
Weave in maths — selling tickets, counting coins, handing out prizes, keeping score at the games.
Model the fair talk: 'Roll up! Three throws for one coin! Who's the winner?'
Invite families to come along, so the play has a real audience and purpose.
Follow the children — some will run a stall all afternoon, others will play every game twice.
key_questions: What stalls and games shall we have at our fair?
How many tickets for a go — how many coins is that?
Who won — how did we keep score?
What job do you need to do to run your stall?
How can we make our fair fun for everyone who comes?

impact.text: Children plan and run stalls with real jobs and cooperative roles.
Children count coins, sell tickets and keep score, using number in play.
Children work together to prepare and host the fair and take pride in it.
Children use rich talk to run stalls and welcome visitors.
Children take on physical games — throwing, aiming, splashing — with control.

enhancements: Stalls to build and run — tombola, hoopla, cake stall, lucky dip, coconut shy.
A ticket booth with tickets to make and coins to count.
Bunting, posters and signs for the children to make and put up.
A face-painting or craft stall for creative fair fun.
A family invitation so the fair has real visitors.

playing_exploring: Children throw themselves into running stalls and playing every game.
They prepare and decorate the fair with enthusiasm.
active_learning: Children run a stall and keep it going through the whole fair.
They see the preparation and hosting through to the end.
creating_thinking: Children plan the fair and solve how to run each stall.
They reason about tickets, coins and keeping score.
